title: Caspase Activity Assays
author: Kiichi Hirota
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.v7je9kn
materials: The following day, cells were treated with reagents for varying lengths of time.

steps.title: Seed cells and incubate
steps.instruction: Seed cells into 96‑well plates and incubate overnight at appropriate culture conditions.

steps.title: Add Apo‑ONE Caspase reagent
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL of Apo‑ONE® Caspase‑3/7 Reagent to each well.

steps.title: Incubate at room temperature
steps.instruction: Incubate the plate at room temperature for 1 hour.

steps.title: Measure luminescence
steps.instruction: Measure luminescence of each well using an EnSpire® Multimode Plate Reader (PerkinElmer, Waltham, MA, USA).

steps.title: Calculate caspase activity
steps.instruction: Calculate caspase activity by comparing luminescence of treated cells to control cells (no drug), defining the control as 100 %. Perform assays in triplicate at least twice and express results as mean ± standard deviation (SD).

substeps.instruction: Compare treated‑cell luminescence to control‑cell luminescence.
Run each condition in triplicate and repeat the entire experiment at least twice.
Report the data as mean ± SD.
